build: Plain JS/CSS without frontend bundler or TypeScript project; no native rebuild. Syntax, behavior, native protocol integrity and real Flash/browser validations are separate.

diffCheck.scope: staged source, tests, documentation and evidence

credentialScan.scope: credential-shaped API tokens, bearer values and private-key blocks; only filenames would be reported

artifactFormatting: Trailing whitespace normalized in text/TAP logs only. Downloaded CSV/BOM/CRLF and PNG bytes preserved.
